build.locales: FormatJS Chromium subset; magrinj shipping compiled data

build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three full 30-case invocations per host: before/after/magrinj in rounds 1 and 3; reverse order in round 2. No builds or profiling during timing runs.
outputChecks: 270 values checked; all FormatJS values match. Only comparator difference is documented unsupported qzz default en-US versus en. All ListFormat/RelativeTimeFormat constructor cases now check resolved locale outside timing.

conformance.gates: 42 targeted Rust, TS/Rust differential, Hermes, Test262 and independent ICU tests pass
conformance.icuMatching: Pinned ICU4J grid checked through legacy and owned matching paths, cold and indexed warm, preserving locale and winning request index
conformance.icuFormatting: Pinned ICU4C/J/X ListFormat, PluralRules and Collator oracles pass; existing explicit formatting differences retained
conformance.mutation: Removing snapshot invalidation fails both public registration regressions. Removing special-locale index barriers fails ICU4J grid. Correct source restored and unit suites rerun.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts and 69 Collator fixtures pass with rebuilt consumer

commands.overlap: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode; run its cquery artifact on each optimized host

rustStages.trialNotes: Snapshot-only still scans exact candidates. Bypass removes that scan but regresses exact en from ~70ns to ~445ns; shipping index retains cheap initial exact matching. Baseline shared-wrapper stage is the registry matching path before migration.

isolatedLocaleControl.execution: Runtime-source outer harness, optimized embedded factories. Extracted unchanged case/harness from overlap.js. Supplemental causal check, not a replacement for full optimized-bytecode runs.
isolatedLocaleControl.interpretation: Full mixed-workload Locale.new(diverse) median rises 3.94 to 4.61us with overlapping run ranges. Isolated paired medians are both 4.18us. The mixed-run shift does not reproduce in isolation; causality remains unproven.
